prompt: Which Fire TV remote button opens the item highlighted on screen?
fact: The D-pad moves the highlight, and the OK or center button activates it.

prompt: What does Reduced FX do in the Snow Media game lounge?
fact: Reduced FX keeps gameplay clear while using simpler animation on lower-powered TV devices.

prompt: For consistent 4K streaming, what connection speed does the in-app test recommend?
fact: Snow Media Center recommends at least 25 Mbps for consistent 4K streaming.

prompt: Below which speed does Snow Media Center warn that HD may buffer?
fact: The app warns that speeds below 15 Mbps can cause buffering for HD streams.

prompt: Which set names the main kinds of content available in the Snow Media Player?
fact: The Player brings Live TV, movies, and series together in one TV-friendly experience.

prompt: Your Dreamstreams or Vibez username and password are primarily used for what?
fact: Dreamstreams and Vibez credentials are streaming logins used by the Player.

prompt: Is a Snow Media website account the same thing as a streaming login?
fact: The website account and streaming login are separate, so changing one does not replace the other.

prompt: What is the billing account area designed to manage?
fact: The billing area is for plans, renewals, trials, gift codes, and related account tasks.

prompt: What can a free Snow Media website account help you keep track of?
answers: Purchases, support replies, and profile details
fact: The optional website account connects purchases, support tickets and replies, messages, and profile details.

prompt: What built-in Snow Media tool can help diagnose a buffering connection?
fact: The built-in Internet Speed Test measures the connection on the same device used for streaming.

prompt: Where would you go in Snow Media Center to ask the Snow Media AI for help?
fact: Snow Media AI lives with the other help tools in the Support experience.

prompt: What is the Main Apps area for?
fact: Main Apps helps viewers download, install, update, and open supported companion apps.

prompt: What shortcut opens favorite and report options for a Live TV channel?
fact: Pressing and holding a channel opens quick favorite and report actions with the channel already filled in.

prompt: Which tool was added in Snow Media Center version 1.0.2?
fact: Version 1.0.2 added the built-in Speed Test and interactive Buffering Guide.

prompt: Which playful currencies arrived with the upgraded Game Room in version 1.5.1?
fact: Version 1.5.1 introduced Snow Gems, bonus Snow Coins, and a TV-fitted Game Room.

prompt: Which classic TV feature arrived in Snow Media Center version 1.5.7?
fact: Version 1.5.7 added the full EPG Guide under Live TV.

prompt: What new viewing area was introduced in version 1.5.8?
fact: Version 1.5.8 introduced Movies & Shows powered by Plex, plus in-app requests.

prompt: What did Multi-Screen add in version 1.6?
answers: Two or four channels at once
fact: Multi-Screen added layouts for watching two or four channels at the same time.

prompt: The in-app speed test shows 11 Mbps on your TV box. What does the Buffering Guide suggest trying?
answers: Use 5 GHz Wi-Fi, move closer, or connect Ethernet
fact: The Buffering Guide flags under 15 Mbps on the streaming device and suggests 5 GHz Wi-Fi, moving closer, or Ethernet.

prompt: Which pair matches Snow Media’s in-app download-speed guidance?
fact: The Buffering Guide uses 15 Mbps for HD; the Speed Test recommends at least 25 Mbps for consistent 4K.

prompt: Why run the Speed Test on the TV box that is buffering?
fact: A phone’s speed can differ from the connection the streaming box actually uses.

prompt: If game animation is heavy on an older TV box, which lounge setting keeps play but lightens effects?
fact: Reduced FX uses simpler game effects without changing the game rules.

prompt: In the streaming sign-in screen, a username formatted as an email connects to which service?
fact: The Player sign-in form routes email usernames to VibezTV.

prompt: In the same streaming sign-in screen, a non-email username connects to which service?
fact: The Player sign-in form routes other usernames to Dreamstreams.

prompt: Which account signs you into the Player rather than tracking website purchases and support?
fact: The streaming login is for the Player; the separate website account covers purchases, support and profile details.

prompt: Where would you redeem a gift code or renew a Dreamstreams plan?
fact: The billing account area handles plans, renewals, trials and gift codes.

prompt: Only one Live TV channel has a problem. What is the Buffering Guide’s first branch?
fact: The guide separates one bad channel or title from widespread buffering and points a single-item issue to reporting.

prompt: Which order does the Buffering Guide use to refresh a misbehaving streaming app?
answers: Turn off the TV, then change input
Delete your account, then sign in
fact: The guide’s refresh step says Force Stop, then Clear Cache, then return to the guide.

prompt: What can you open by pressing and holding a focused Live TV channel?
fact: The channel shortcut opens favorite and report actions with category and channel filled in.

prompt: Why does the Multi-Screen web preview show an install-app message?
answers: It needs the native Fire TV / Android players
It only works on a phone
It is part of the trivia game
fact: Multi-Screen uses native video players for two or four simultaneous channels.

prompt: Which release paired the cable-grid EPG Guide with Saved Accounts and Appearance settings?
fact: Version 1.5.7 added the full Guide, Saved Accounts and Appearance options.

prompt: Which release brought Plex Movies & Shows and an in-app Request tab together?
fact: Version 1.5.8 introduced Movies & Shows powered by Plex and the Request tab.

prompt: Which release added the press-and-hold channel shortcut for favorites and reporting?
fact: Version 1.5.6 added the channel hold shortcut with the report details prefilled.

prompt: Which release brought tickets, AI chat, videos and the Buffering Guide together under Support?
fact: The 1.1.0 release notes describe the unified Support area.

prompt: Your box measures 20 Mbps. Which reading best matches the app’s HD and 4K advice?
answers: Above the HD target, below the 4K recommendation
Above both the HD and 4K targets
fact: 20 Mbps clears the 15 Mbps HD guidance but falls short of the 25 Mbps recommendation for consistent 4K.

prompt: Your phone tests fast but the streaming box tests at 9 Mbps. Which result should guide troubleshooting?
fact: The Buffering Guide asks for the speed on the device doing the streaming, because its Wi-Fi path may differ.

prompt: With a VPN connected, the box still tests below 15 Mbps. What does the Buffering Guide suggest next?
answers: Pick a closer VPN city and retest
Try a more distant VPN city first
Treat the phone’s speed as the box’s result
fact: The VPN step advises a closer VPN city and another speed test when the result stays under 15 Mbps.

prompt: An older box feels sluggish with the home Content Bar running. Which app setting can reduce that load?
answers: Disable the Content Bar in Settings
Refresh the Live TV channel list
fact: The app’s release guidance points older or slower devices to the Content Bar toggle in Settings.

prompt: A viewer can open their Snow Media website purchases but not Live TV. Which credential should they check?
answers: Their Dreamstreams or Vibez streaming login
fact: Website purchases and the Player use separate account paths; the Player needs the streaming login.

prompt: A viewer enters an email-style streaming username and wants to renew a Dreamstreams plan. Which pairing is right?
answers: Email routes to Vibez; plan renewal is in Billing
Email routes to Dreamstreams; renew in Player
Email routes to Vibez; renew in Live TV Guide
Email routes to a website account; renew in Player
fact: Email-style Player usernames route to VibezTV, while Dreamstreams plan tasks live in the billing account area.

prompt: What else happens when you sign in with Dreamstreams or Vibez through My Account?
answers: The Player is signed in too
The website account password is replaced
Plex links without its own sign-in
fact: The account chooser says the Dreamstreams/Vibez sign-in also signs the viewer into the Player.

prompt: Which streaming service does the Buffering Guide explicitly say its VPN step does not work with?
fact: The guide’s VPN note specifically excludes VibezTV.

prompt: One channel fails, but the others play. Which action is more targeted than changing the whole network setup?
answers: Run a VPN test for every service
Refresh the entire channel list first
fact: The Buffering Guide first distinguishes an isolated channel or title issue from a broader connection problem.

prompt: After checking whether the issue affects one item or many, what is the guide’s next troubleshooting sequence?
answers: Refresh app, test speed, then consider VPN
VPN, test speed, then refresh app
Test speed, renew plan, then refresh app
Refresh app, switch accounts, then request a title
fact: The Buffering Guide goes from one-or-all to app refresh, device speed and finally VPN testing.

prompt: A requested movie is missing from Plex, but Live TV works. Which Player area was added for that task?
fact: The Movies & Shows release added an in-app Request tab for movies and shows.

prompt: Why can the installed TV app run four-channel Multi-Screen when the web preview cannot?
answers: It uses four native video players
It uses four browser picture-in-picture windows
It shares one web video element across tiles
fact: Multi-Screen’s native implementation runs up to four video-player tiles; the web preview cannot provide that path.

prompt: Which 1.5.7 feature set is correctly matched?
answers: Multi-Screen, player volume slider, Plex quality selector
Plex Request tab, Movies & Shows, Content Bar links
Plex detail pages, episode browsing, subtitle downloads
fact: The 1.5.7 notes group the cable-grid Guide, Saved Accounts and Appearance settings.

prompt: What changed together in the Player in version 1.5.8?
answers: Live TV / Movies & Shows choice plus in-app requests
Multi-Screen plus a player volume slider
Plex detail pages plus episode browsing
fact: The 1.5.8 notes describe the two Player choices, Plex Movies & Shows and a Request tab.

prompt: Which Plex improvements belong to version 1.5.9 rather than the first Movies & Shows release?
answers: Detail pages, episode browsing and audio/subtitle controls
The first Movies & Shows choice and Request tab
Four-channel Multi-Screen and a quality selector
The cable-grid Guide and Saved Accounts
fact: Version 1.5.9 expanded Plex detail, episode and playback controls after Movies & Shows arrived in 1.5.8.

prompt: Which pair appears in the 1.6.1 playback notes?
answers: Plex audio fix and 10-second movie pre-buffer
First Plex Movies & Shows choice and Request tab
fact: Version 1.6.1 lists a Plex missing-audio fix and 10 seconds of movie pre-buffering.

prompt: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
fact: Iron minerals in Martian soil oxidize, giving Mars its rusty red color.

prompt: At what temperature does fresh water freeze on the Celsius scale?
fact: At standard atmospheric pressure, fresh water freezes at 0 degrees Celsius.

prompt: Which gas do plants absorb from the air during photosynthesis?
fact: Plants use carbon dioxide, water, and light energy to make sugars and oxygen.

prompt: What is the largest organ of the human body?
fact: The skin is the body’s largest organ and its first protective barrier.

prompt: Where can sound not travel?
fact: Sound needs matter to carry its vibrations, so it cannot cross a true vacuum.

prompt: What is the name of the cowboy toy in Toy Story?
fact: Sheriff Woody is Andy’s pull-string cowboy doll and longtime favorite toy.

prompt: Which character is the snow queen in Frozen?
fact: Elsa has the magical ability to create and control ice and snow.

prompt: Which superhero is the protector of Wakanda?
fact: Black Panther is the heroic title carried by Wakanda’s chosen protector.

prompt: Which hobbit joins a quest to reclaim the Lonely Mountain?
fact: Bilbo Baggins leaves the Shire with Thorin’s company in The Hobbit.

prompt: In which town does The Simpsons family live?
fact: The Simpsons live at 742 Evergreen Terrace in the fictional town of Springfield.

prompt: The pyramids of Giza are located in which country?
fact: The Giza pyramid complex sits just outside Cairo, Egypt.

prompt: Tokyo is the capital city of which country?
fact: Tokyo is Japan’s capital and the center of its largest metropolitan area.

prompt: What is the largest ocean on Earth?
fact: The Pacific Ocean covers more area than all of Earth’s land combined.

prompt: What is the official language of Brazil?
fact: Brazil is the largest Portuguese-speaking country in the world.

prompt: In which city would you find the Eiffel Tower?
fact: The Eiffel Tower was completed in Paris for the 1889 World’s Fair.

prompt: How many keys are on a standard modern piano?
fact: A standard piano has 52 white keys and 36 black keys, for 88 total.

prompt: Who guides an orchestra during a performance?
fact: A conductor coordinates tempo, timing, balance, and expression across the orchestra.

prompt: What does tempo describe in music?
fact: Tempo tells musicians how fast or slowly a piece should be performed.

prompt: Which of these belongs to the brass family?
fact: A trumpet produces sound from vibrating lips through a brass mouthpiece.

prompt: How many strings does a standard violin have?
fact: A standard violin has four strings tuned to G, D, A, and E.

prompt: How many players from one team are on a basketball court at once?
fact: Each basketball team fields five players on the court at a time.

prompt: In tennis scoring, what does “love” mean?
fact: In tennis, “love” is the traditional term for a score of zero.

prompt: Which soccer player may use their hands inside the penalty area?
fact: The goalkeeper may handle the ball inside their own penalty area.

prompt: How many rings appear on the Olympic symbol?
fact: The five interlocking Olympic rings represent the union of five inhabited continents.

prompt: What position ends a game of chess with a winner?
fact: Checkmate means the king is threatened and has no legal way to escape.

prompt: Which mammal is capable of true sustained flight?
fact: Bats are the only mammals that can power and sustain true flight.

prompt: What is the largest animal known to have lived on Earth?
fact: A blue whale can grow beyond 30 meters and weigh well over 100 tons.

prompt: What is a young frog called before it grows legs?
fact: A tadpole begins life in water and transforms through metamorphosis.

prompt: What is the home of a honeybee colony called?
fact: Honeybees live together in colonies housed in nests commonly called hives.

prompt: Which animal is the fastest runner on land?
fact: A cheetah can accelerate rapidly and sprint at highway speeds for short bursts.
